messages:
elaine_sales: Stratagem POC demo just hit repeated 429s during a live run at ~10:12am PDT. They had 3 concurrent users doing long chat loops. Noticed it during the 'generate' route. Can eng triage? @vivian_se @mike_oncall

vivian_se: Thanks. Which model and "max_tokens" did they set? Any per-route config? Also do we have the request ids/log snippets?

elaine_sales: Model=redwood-xt-4k, max_tokens=800, streaming=false. I attached the console screenshots from their demo (they pasted logs) — sending raw snippets below.

mike_oncall: Pulling logs now. Standby.

mike_oncall: OK logs show repeated 429s from the gateway with body:
```
{"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","retry_after_ms":1500,"route":"/v1/generate"}
```
Headers include X-RateLimit-Limit=6000, X-RateLimit-Remaining=0, X-RateLimit-Reset=1643

vivian_se: Looks like they exhausted the tenant token budget in the burst window. They're hitting long contexts (800 tokens output) which eats tokens fast. Are they using per-request token_count accounting? Also check if per-route cap is lower than tenant

mike_oncall: Confirmed: tenant monthly token quota is fine, but the burst-window token bucket (per-minute) for their trial tier is 1.2M tokens/min, and their long-running concurrent flows ate it. The gateway enforces both tenant burst and per-route caps. Per-route for '/v1/generate' is set to 400k tokens/min for trial.

elaine_sales: Customer says they need to show end-to-end demo in the next 6 hours. Can we do a temporary bump or workaround?

vivian_se: Two short options:
1) Temporary per-route cap bump to 1M tokens/min for the POC for 24h (quick, needs ops approval)
2) Short-term tweak: set client-side max_tokens=256 and enable prefix caching for repeated prompts to reduce token burn (we can send a recommended prompt config)

mike_oncall: I'm happy to request a 24h bump. If we do that we should also add a safeguard: rate-limit annotation to avoid infinite burn. I'll open an ops ticket and mark it high priority.

infra-bot: Ops request created — ticket CI-4582. Assigned to eng-platform. ETA 45m for manual bump.

vivian_se: Also sending a small snippet to suggest to customer to reduce max_tokens and enable streaming. Example curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
 -d '{"model":"redwood-xt-4k","max_tokens":256,"stream":true,"input":"<their prompt>"}'
```

elaine_sales: I'll ping Stratagem and recommend the shorter max_tokens + streaming as immediate mitigation while ops works the bump. Can we also confirm if per-route caps are adjustable per-customer in Dedicated? Customer is worried about predictability.

mike_oncall: Yes, for Dedicated and Reserved we can set per-tenant route caps. For hosted trial it's a global tier setting but we can do temporary manual edits.

vivian_se: Sending the quick config note to Stratagem now and asking them to confirm they can switch to streaming. If they can't, we'll proceed with the 24h bump.

elaine_sales: Thanks all — I'll update channel after Stratagem reply. :thumbsup:

mike_oncall: Follow-up: ops is ready to apply the bump. Please confirm customer acknowledgement and we'll schedule the window (start in ~10m). If they want logs from the change we'll capture pre/post X-RateLimit headers.

elaine_sales: Customer confirmed, starting demo in 12m. Please apply bump for 24h now. Really appreciate the fast turnaround.

infra-bot: Ops applied manual per-route cap update. New '/v1/generate' tokens/min = 1000000 for tenant stratagem-123. Change ID: CHG-7729.

mike_oncall: Monitor their X-RateLimit-Remaining over next 15m. I'll keep an eye on backend errors. If anything spikes we'll revert.

vivian_se: Heads-up for follow-up: recommend a long-term approach - either dedicated capacity or configuring streaming + smaller max_tokens and KV caching. I'll draft a short doc for sales to attach.

elaine_sales: Awesome. Closing the POC triage loop — will follow up with post-mortem if anything else. :raised_hands:
